_comment: Thresholds of radot check (heuristics, generous on purpose). Sections are merged with a user file given with --thresholds.

injected_activity_mbq._comment: Plausible injected activity per radionuclide (MBq), therapy and imaging; 'default' for the others.

ct._comment: Values below padding_below_hu are padding outside the field of view (ignored). Max below mu_map_max: not HU.

activity_image._comment: Integer values with a max below counts_max: probably counts, not an activity.

activity_balance._comment: Fraction of the injected activity (decay-corrected) in the image: FAIL above max_fraction (units, calibration) or below min_fraction (uncalibrated counts), WARN below warn_below. mtp_tolerance: allowed excess over the physical decay between time points. lr_min_ratio: minimum ratio of the mean activity of left/right uptake organs (kidneys).

geom._comment: overlap: fraction of the activity inside the CT field of view. organs: substrings of ROI names (lower case) of the uptake organs checked by geom.overlap and geom.organ_shift. body: fraction of the activity inside the CT body (HU > -500, largest component, dilated). organ_shift: shift of the label within +-shift_search_mm that maximises its activity; WARN above shift_warn_mm if the counts increase by more than shift_min_gain; organs with a mean below min_uptake x the mean activity are skipped.

roi._comment: min_volume_ml: smaller ROIs reported. mass_ratio: ROI mass (CT density) / OpenDose reference mass, only for these whole organs (OpenDose name, lower case). organ_side: patient side of unpaired organs (catches mirrored images). tissue_classes: substrings of the ROI name (lower case) -> class, first match; mean_hu: expected mean CT value per class.
